main.description: A judgment-log batch, v2 (step3 Phase 1): operations whose fold VALIDATES A PRECONDITION and DISCARDS anything that fails it (the participation roster). Kept apart from app.conversensus.v2.batch because graph ops resolve by LWW / add-wins and have no notion of an invalid op. The rkey scheme and the causal point (seq, deps) are SHARED with the graph batches of the same file: preconditions say 'recorded before this operation', so the two logs must be orderable against one another.

fileId.description: The file this judgment belongs to (UUID).

actor.description: did#deviceId. The roster is keyed by DID, not by actor, so a second device of the same person is not a second participant.

clock.description: Lamport clock, in the same space as the graph batches.

seq.description: The actor's sequence number, shared with the graph batches of the same file. The participation genesis uses 0.

deps.description: Causal context (actor -> seq), as on graph batches.
